faq_heading: Homes near Janice Churchill Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Janice Churchill Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Janice Churchill Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Janice Churchill Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Janice Churchill Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 39 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,375,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Janice Churchill Elementary?
faq.a: Near Janice Churchill Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 40 days to sell and closed at 96.0% of the list price, with 3% over asking, across 39 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Janice Churchill Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km north-east), Enver Creek Secondary (0.4 km north-west) and Maple Green Elementary (0.8 km north-east).

Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Janice Churchill Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Janice Churchill Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Janice Churchill Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Janice Churchill Elementary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Janice Churchill Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 8 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Cornerstone Montessori School, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cindrich Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Enver Creek Secondary (0.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km north-east), Maple Green Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Brookside Elementary (1.0 km north-west), Green Timbers Elementary (1.3 km north), Chimney Hill Elementary (1.7 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Cornerstone Montessori School, 0.4 km north-east of Janice Churchill Elementary.
